epic.name: File upload
unverifiedAssumptions: A file over 10 MB should show "The file is too large. Files can be up to 10 MB." through the app proxy (not a generic upload failure). Claude verifies this against the real back-end at manual test.
A real upload's progress bar moves through the app proxy (Claude verifies at manual test).
Several server validation messages at once are shown together on one line. Readable enough?
An unexpected server answer keeps the file and offers "Try again" with "The file could not be uploaded." Right offer?
